correctness.rationale: Triangle-free cubic structure excludes connected forcing seeds of size at most 3; the exhaustive four-vertex shape classification reduces every minimum seed to P4 or a rung C4. Four explicit forcing waves work for the four symmetry classes. A complete modular table of every three-overlap replacement gives degrees (6,6,8,6), orbit sizes (2n,4n,n,2n), 28n edges, and connectivity through the two straight-path cycles and square connectors. Two separately implemented Python verifiers establish exhaustive checks for 6<=n<=15 and independent symmetry/local checks for 6<=n<=35. Infinite conclusions depend on the written structural proof, not extrapolation.
risks: Manual correctness of the modular exchange table is important, especially at n=6; both checks include that endpoint.
Finite scripts do not establish the infinite quantifier, which is instead handled by the symbolic orbit and local-case argument.

value.rationale: The published optimum cardinality does not answer how many connected optimal seeds exist or whether all such seeds can be exchanged while retaining optimality and initial connectedness. The complete orbit description, exact 9n count, connectedness and 28n-edge/degree law establish the geometry of the natural constrained configuration space throughout an infinite family of cubic planar graphs. These are structural reconfiguration invariants rather than a routine reproof of the known minimum size.
risks: The family is specially structured; no general reconfiguration algorithm or diameter formula is claimed.
